scoring_justification: The computed values are deterministic physical constants from given inputs; recomputing them would require re-running the full lattice-sum pipeline in the verifier sandbox, which is infeasible. The gold values are reported in the paper and confirmed by the reference solution.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for all scored artifacts
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper 'A theory of long-periodic structures in MX2 solids based on ANNNI alternated model.' Eq.(17) for Coulomb-only exchange parameters, Eq.(15) for α,β, and the text for bond length R₀=8.75 a.u.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values extracted from the paper and cross-checked with the reference solution (solve.sh) that writes the exact same numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact reported quantities in the paper for CdI₂ under the specified model; they are the authoritative target of the reproduction.

outputs.description: Coulomb-only exchange parameters J₁, J₂/J₁, K/J₁.
Coefficients α, β of the linear relation B_XM = α + β(B_XX + B_MM).

output_contract.notes: All physical quantities in atomic units unless noted. The scored outputs are checked by the hidden verifier; the exact gold values are not part of the public contract.
